angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 173,925 km at 6.25 pc = 0.37 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 159.9085 +/- 0.0513 mas (same row, RUWE 1.59): 6.25 pc, no zero-point correction; the RUWE is high, so the astrometry fits a single star poorly, and the parallax is used as published
radiusSource: Radius 0.25 solar radii from Morin et al., arXiv:0808.1423, Table 1: radius 0.25 solar radii (theoretical radius; R sin i = 0.23(1)) (https://arxiv.org/abs/0808.1423): 173,925 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.25 solar masses from Morin et al., arXiv:0808.1423, Table 1: mass 0.25 solar masses (https://arxiv.org/abs/0808.1423); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3210 K from Pecaut & Mamajek (2013, ApJS 208, 9), the online table's version 2022.04.16, row M4V, for SIMBAD's spectral type M4.0Ve: Teff (https://www.pas.rochester.edu/~emamajek/EEM_dwarf_UBVIJHK_colors_Teff.txt). Spin inclination 60 degrees and rotation period 0.405 d from Morin et al., arXiv:0808.1423, Table 1: rotation period 0.405 d and an axis 60 degrees from the line of sight, the values its magnetic maps were made with (https://arxiv.org/abs/0808.1423). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Pecaut & Mamajek (2013, ApJS 208, 9), the online table's version 2022.04.16, row M4V, for SIMBAD's spectral type M4.0Ve: Teff (https://www.pas.rochester.edu/~emamajek/EEM_dwarf_UBVIJHK_colors_Teff.txt)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/eq-pegasi-b.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 5.040, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, BD+19 5116B: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
rotationPeriodSource: VizieR J/MNRAS/441/2361/table1 (Stellar magnetism, age and rotation), column Prot: 0.4 d, the row 0.9 arcsec from the star's J2000 place. The middle of 7 catalogued periods, 5 of them within 20% of it
